rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "high"
    strings:
        $x64_get_uri = "token.php" nocase
        $sleeptime = { 00 00 0[1-3] 00 } // typical sleep time encoding
        $public_key = { 00 00 00 80 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 [0-255] 43 6F 62 61 6C 74 } // RSA public key + "Cobalt"
    condition:
        $x64_get_uri and $sleeptime and $public_key
}
